title: Light Venezuelan Turkey Neck Bento Box
description: A light and nutty Venezuelan dish featuring a crispy fried turkey neck served in a bento box.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Cut the turkey necks into 1-inch pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
Once the oil is hot, carefully add the turkey neck pieces and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the fried turkey necks from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a separate pan, heat the Arroz Amarillo according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated yuca and crispy plantain chips.

To assemble the bento box, place a portion of the fried turkey necks on the bottom, followed by a scoop of the Arroz Amarillo, a sprinkle of the yuca and plantain chip mixture, and a drizzle of sour orange juice if using.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve in individual bento boxes for a fun and easy meal.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
